name: Amitriptyline
summary: Amitriptyline, formerly sold under the brand names Elavil or Endep, among others, is a tricyclic antidepressant primarily used to treat major depressive disorder, and a variety of pain syndromes such as neuropathic pain, fibromyalgia, migraine and tension headaches. Due to the frequency and prominence of side effects, amitriptyline is generally considered a second-line therapy for these indications.

pharmacology.text: Amitriptyline inhibits serotonin transporter (SERT) and norepinephrine transporter (NET). It is metabolized to nortriptyline, a stronger norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor, further augmenting amitriptyline's effects on norepinephrine reuptake (see table in this section).

uses.text: Amitriptyline is indicated for the treatment of major depressive disorder, neuropathic pain, and for the prevention of migraine and chronic tension headache. It can be used for the treatment of nocturnal enuresis in children older than 6 after other treatments have failed.

sideEffects.text: The most common side effects are dry mouth, drowsiness, dizziness, constipation, and weight gain. Glaucoma, liver toxicity and abnormal heart rhythms are rare but serious side effects.

summaryZh: 阿米替林（英語：Amitriptyline）以Elavil等商品名於市面銷售，是一種三環類抗憂鬱藥，主要用於治療重度憂鬱症和各種疼痛症候群，如神經性疼痛、纖維肌痛、偏頭痛和緊縮型頭痛。因使用而發生副作用的頻率高，並且顯著，藥物通常被當作此類適應症的二線藥物。
summaryZhHans: 阿米替林（英语：Amitriptyline）以Elavil等商品名于市面销售，是一种三环类抗忧郁药，主要用于治疗重度忧郁症和各种疼痛症候群，如神经性疼痛、纤维肌痛、偏头痛和紧缩型头痛。因使用而发生副作用的频率高，并且显著，药物通常被当作此类适应症的二线药物。

fact.en: Amitriptyline reached the market in 1961 and is still on the World Health Organization's list of essential medicines. These days it is prescribed more often for nerve pain and migraine prevention than for depression.
fact.zh: 阿米替林於 1961 年上市，至今仍列在世界衛生組織的基本藥物清單中。如今它用於神經痛與預防偏頭痛的處方，反而比用於憂鬱症更常見。
fact.zhHans: 阿米替林于 1961 年上市，至今仍列在世界卫生组织的基本药物清单中。如今它用于神经痛与预防偏头痛的处方，反而比用于忧郁症更常见。
